Here, by solving the Boltzmann transport equation considering both three- and four-phonon interactions, we observe that isotopically pure cubic germanium carbide (GeC) exhibits a remarkable $κ$ of 1018 W m$^{-1}$ K$^{-1}$ at room temperature, which is further corroborated by state-of-the-art machine-learning molecular dynamics simulations. Two unique mechanisms underlie this anomalously high $κ$: a remarkably strong isotopic enhancement effect (289%) and a surprisingly modest suppression due to four-phonon scattering (22%)-despite the presence of a wide acoustic-optical phonon gap. Moreover, we find that GeC defies the conventional Leibfried-Schlomann formula and exhibits a non-monotonic variation of $κ$ with external hydrostatic pressure at elevated temperatures. Our findings establish isotope-enriched GeC as a material of ultrahigh $κ$ and an ideal platform for exploring exotic phonon physics.

AI.tldr: 通过求解包含三声子和四声子相互作用的玻尔兹曼输运方程，发现同位素纯立方碳化锗(GeC)室温热导率高达1018 W m⁻¹K⁻¹，机制为强同位素增强效应与弱四声子抑制。
AI.motivation: 现代电子器件散热热流密度接近1000 W cm⁻²，迫切需要热导率超过1000 W m⁻¹K⁻¹的材料。
AI.method: 求解考虑三声子和四声子相互作用的玻尔兹曼输运方程，并用先进的机器学习分子动力学模拟进行交叉验证。
AI.result: 同位素纯立方GeC室温热导率达1018 W m⁻¹K⁻¹；其来源为289%的强同位素增强效应和仅22%的四声子散射抑制（尽管存在宽声学-光学声子带隙）；GeC违背传统Leibfried-Schlomann公式，高温下热导率随静水压呈非单调变化。
AI.conclusion: 同位素富集GeC是一种超高导热材料，也是探索新奇声子物理的理想平台。

title: First-principles study of the formation of Group-IV--vacancy color centers in diamond
summary: $XV$ ($X$ is Si, Ge, Sn, or Pb, and $V$ is the carbon vacancy) color centers are promising platforms for quantum computing and quantum information science due to their favorable optical and spin properties. They are commonly fabricated by ion implantation, which inevitably introduces vacancies and carbon self-interstitials (C$_i$) into the lattice. However, the microscopic formation mechanism remains unclear, limiting the yield and stability of $XV$ centers. Here, first-principles calculations are conducted to systematically investigate the roles of $V$ and C$_i$ in $XV$ formation. We find that $XV$ formation is energetically favorable, with large binding energies and low diffusion barriers. Nevertheless, $XV$ readily captures C$_i$ to form substitutional defect $X_s$, or captures an additional $V$ to form the complex $XV_2$. Charge transition levels show that oppositely charged reactants never meet in these reactions, and that Coulomb repulsion blocks them only when both reactants carry charges of the same sign, which for the capture of C$_i$ requires strongly n- or p-type conditions. These competing defect reactions destabilize the split-vacancy configuration and could account for the low formation yield of $XV$ centers, so that they appear at concentrations well below those expected from the implanted dose. Our results elucidate the microscopic origin of this intrinsic instability and suggest that Fermi-level control may suppress defect conversions and stabilize the split-vacancy configuration.

AI.tldr: 第一性原理计算揭示XV色心形成机制及其低产率原因：XV形成虽能量有利，但易俘获C_i生成X_s或俘获额外V生成XV_2，这些竞争反应破坏split-vacancy结构。
AI.motivation: XV色心（X=Si/Ge/Sn/Pb，V=碳空位）具优良光学与自旋性质，是量子计算与量子信息的有力平台；但常用离子注入制备会引入空位和碳自间隙原子(C_i)，其微观形成机制不清，导致XV色心产率和稳定性受限。
AI.method: 采用第一性原理计算，系统研究V与C_i在XV形成中的作用，计算结合能、扩散势垒及反应俘获过程，并分析各缺陷的电荷跃迁能级及相关反应物的带电状态与库仑相互作用。
AI.result: XV形成能量有利、结合能大、扩散势垒低；但XV易俘获C_i形成替位缺陷X_s，或俘获额外V形成XV_2复合体。电荷跃迁能级表明异号带电反应物不会相遇（反应已发生），同号带电时库仑斥力阻碍反应；俘获C_i需强n型或p型条件。
AI.conclusion: 竞争性缺陷反应使split-vacancy构型失稳，可解释XV色心形成产率低（浓度远低于注入剂量预期）的内禀不稳定性微观起源；费米能级调控或可抑制缺陷转化、稳定split-vacancy构型。

title: Millikelvin magnetometry up to 30~T using a multi-cross micro-Hall sensor
comment: To appear in Chinese Physics B
summary: We report a multi-cross micro-Hall sensor fabricated from an MBE-grown GaAs/AlGaAs heterostructure for high-sensitivity magnetometry. The device enables dc magnetization measurements at temperatures down to $\sim$15~mK and in dc magnetic fields up to 30 T. Bulk samples with dimensions ranging from 100~$μ$m to 1~mm can be measured with a resolution better than 1$~μ$T with a 1~$μ$A excitation at 13.77 Hz. Test-of-performance measurements were carried out by probing the field-dependent magnetization plateaus of the triangular-lattice quantum magnet K$_{2}$Co$_{2}$(SeO$_{3}$)$_{3}$ at 20~mK, the antiferromagnetic transition of K${_3}$GdTe${_2}$O${_9}$ near 220 mK via temperature-dependent magnetization, and the quantum oscillations in a ruthenium single crystal. A simple and reliable sample-mounting setup that ensures reproducible magnetic measurements is provided.

AI.tldr: 报道了一种基于GaAs/AlGaAs异质结的多十字微霍尔传感器，可在约15 mK至30 T条件下实现高灵敏直流磁化测量（分辨率优于1 μT），并已用多种材料验证其性能。
AI.motivation: 极低温、强磁场下的高灵敏直流磁化测量需求，需要小型化、可重复且可靠的磁测量手段。
AI.method: MBE生长GaAs/AlGaAs异质结构制备多十字微霍尔传感器；11 μA、13.77 Hz激励下测量100 μm–1 mm块体样品；提供保证可重复性的简易样品安装方案。
AI.result: 在K2Co2(SeO3)3中于20 mK观测到场致磁化平台；在K3GdTe2O9中于约220 mK测得反铁磁转变；在Ru单晶中观测到量子振荡。
AI.conclusion: 该微霍尔传感器是一种适用于极低温强磁场块体样品的高灵敏、可重复的直流磁测量工具。

title: Hidden entropic order of emergent charges in a classical Ampère spin liquid
comment: Main text: 7 pages, 5 figures. Supplemental Material: 9 pages, 11 figures
summary: Classical spin liquids are characterized by an extensive number of ground-state configurations. Coulomb spin liquids have, in this ground-state manifold, a divergence-free local constraint, which gives dipolar correlations and pinch points in the structure factor. Recently, models with a complementary ground-state constraint, defined by a zero-circulation constraint (Ampère's law), have been proposed. While classical Coulomb spin liquids forbid emergent charges, their Ampère counterparts leave the charges unconstrained. Here we study an Ising Ampère model on the octochlore lattice. The ground states obey a Gauss law for an antisymmetric rank-two field, i.e., three coupled two-dimensional Gauss laws, which are expected to produce pinch points in the structure factor. Nevertheless, maximal charges, vertices with all six arrows in or out, spontaneously accumulate on one of the two sublattices of the cubic lattice, with disordered signs. This order has a purely entropic origin; it washes out the pinch-point singularities at large scales, produces no magnetic Bragg peaks, and coexists with an extensive entropy. The system enters into this sublattice long-range ordered state through a continuous transition in what seems to be the three-dimensional Ising universality class. Moreover, the state has no magnetic order; it is even under time reversal: it is a hidden, entropic order within the Ampère manifold. Thus, a system whose Gauss law would predict an algebraic spin liquid becomes, through a non-magnetic ordering transition, a partially ordered short-range spin liquid. Our study is based on a combination of the constraint-vector theory, exact bounds and enumeration, and Monte Carlo, Wang-Landau, and parallel-tempering simulations.

AI.tldr: 本文研究八氯格点上的Ising Ampère模型，发现其基态虽满足反对称二阶张量的Gauss定律（预期给出spin liquid与pinch points），却因纯熵驱动的最大电荷在立方子格上的自发聚集，经由三维Ising普适类的连续相变进入一种无磁序的隐藏熵序，使pinch点在大尺度被洗掉，系统成为部分有序的短程spin liquid。
AI.motivation: 经典Coulomb spin liquid在基态流形上带有无散度局部约束，产生偶极关联与结构因子中的pinch points；近期提出与之互补的零环流约束（Ampère定律）模型，其基态不约束涌现电荷。作者希望探究这种Ampère型约束在具体格点（八氯格点）上是否真的实现预期的代数spin liquid，还是会出现新的、由约束本身衍生的非平凡序。
AI.method: 采用约束矢量理论、精确界与精确枚举，并结合Monte Carlo、Wang-Landau与parallel-tempering模拟，对八氯格点上的Ising Ampère模型进行系统性研究。
AI.result: 基态满足反对称二阶场的Gauss定律（三个耦合的二维Gauss定律），本应产生pinch points；但实际上“最大电荷”顶点（六条箭头全进或全出）自发聚集在立方晶格两个子格之一上，且符号无序。该序为纯熵起源，在大尺度上抹去pinch点奇异性，不产生磁Bragg峰，并与广延熵共存。系统经由看似三维Ising普适类的连续相变进入该子格长程有序态；该态无磁序，对时间反演为偶，是Ampère流形中的隐藏熵序。
AI.conclusion: 一个按Gauss定律本应表现为代数spin liquid的系统，通过一次非磁性有序相变，转变为部分有序的短程spin liquid。这揭示了Ampère约束下熵驱动隐藏序可以破坏预期的代数关联，为识别和分类新型spin liquid相提供了重要判据。

title: Evolutionary Design of Interpretable Spatial Descriptors for Structure-Property Relationship Discovery
summary: Structure property prediction is a classical task in machine learning, ranging from molecular activity and materials properties to local functional responses measured in microscopy. For image-based regression, two choices define the information available to the predictor: the size of the image neighborhood and the spatial resolution retained within it. A small neighborhood can omit relevant surrounding structure, whereas a large, finely sampled neighborhood can introduce redundant or irrelevant information. Here, we develop a framework for constructing spatial descriptors for prediction of local spectra and hysteresis loops. We benchmark regression models, use SHAP maps to examine their spatial attribution, and explore the effect of the patch size and compression to establish the relationship between predictive accuracy and descriptor dimensionality. We then use a genetic algorithm to optimize spatial partitions and the assignment of mean, minimum, and maximum pooling operations. Each retained region contributes an explicit measurement of the image, allowing the search to balance prediction error against the number of descriptor values. Cartesian and polar constructions provide complementary ways to organize this information. The resulting descriptors make it possible to examine where spatial detail is needed, where regional summaries are sufficient, and how these choices depend on the predictor and the measured response. The same approach can be used for molecules and solids once the genetic algorithm rules for these are established.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个构建空间描述符的框架，用于预测局部光谱与磁滞回线，通过基准回归模型、SHAP空间归因分析、patch尺寸与压缩的影响研究，再用遗传算法优化空间划分与池化操作分配，以在预测误差与描述符维数间取得平衡。
AI.motivation: 图像回归中，邻域大小与空间分辨率决定了预测器可用的信息：小邻域会遗漏相关结构，大而精细采样的邻域又引入冗余或无关信息，需在二者间找到合理权衡。
AI.method: 构建空间描述符框架：基准测试回归模型；用SHAP图分析空间归因；研究patch尺寸与压缩对精度-维数关系的影响；用遗传算法优化空间划分及mean/min/max池化操作分配；并给出笛卡尔与极坐标两种构造方式。
AI.result: 描述符可在预测误差与描述符值数量之间进行权衡优化；笛卡尔与极坐标构造提供互补的信息组织方式，可揭示何处需要空间细节、何处区域汇总已足够，且这些选择依赖预测器与所测响应。
AI.conclusion: 该框架可用于分析局部光谱与磁滞回线预测中的空间信息需求；一旦建立相应遗传算法规则，同样方法可推广到分子与固体。

authors: C. J. L. de la Rosa
title: Hall-Density Collapse as Direct Evidence for Percolative Conduction Onset in Monolayer MoS$_2$ Transistors
comment: 7 pages, 4 figures; Supplemental Material: 12 pages, 7 figures, 1 table. Submitted to Physical Review Letters
summary: The origin of the apparent metal-insulator transition in two-dimensional electron systems remains debated. Using temperature-dependent transport and Hall measurements on industry-relevant MoS$_2$ monolayer FETs with amorphous HfO$_2$ dielectrics, we establish classical percolation as the underlying mechanism. We report two complementary signatures of disorder-driven conduction onset: a temperature-independent Hall-density collapse as a function of absolute gate voltage and a vanishing activation energy at a characteristic carrier density $n_{\mathrm{c}}$, identified as the percolation threshold. These findings identify dielectric-interface disorder, rather than channel quality alone, as the key parameter governing device turn-on. The extracted activation barriers reach values substantially exceeding room-temperature thermal energies, indicating that disorder-driven conduction onset remains relevant well beyond cryogenic transport.

AI.tldr: 在工业相关MoS2单层FET（非晶HfO2介电层）中，经典渗流是表观金属-绝缘体转变的机制，介电界面无序而非沟道质量本身决定器件开启。
AI.motivation: 二维电子系统中表观金属-绝缘体转变的起源仍有争议；需明确区分沟道本征质量与界面无序对导电开启的贡献。
AI.method: 对采用非晶HfO2介电层的MoS2单层FET进行变温输运与霍尔测量，分析霍尔密度随绝对栅压的塌缩行为及特征载流子密度nc处的激活能。
AI.result: 观察到两个互补的渗流特征：霍尔密度随绝对栅压变化而与温度无关地塌缩；在渗流阈值nc处激活能趋于零。提取的激活势垒显著高于室温热能量。
AI.conclusion: 将经典渗流确认为导电开启机制；介电-界面无序是控制器件开启的关键参数，且该无序主导的导电开启在远超低温输运的温区仍具相关性。

title: Thermally Conditioned Time-Series Forecasting of Grain Growth in Polycrystalline Materials
summary: Grain growth during heat treatment strongly affects the microstructure of polycrystalline materials and, consequently, their mechanical properties. Although numerical methods such as front-tracking or front-capturing simulations can accurately describe grain growth, their high computational cost limits their use for long or non-isothermal thermal cycles. In previous work, grain growth was successfully predicted under isothermal conditions by treating grain size distributions as time series and forecasting their evolution using recurrent neural networks, allowing complete grain growth trajectories to be generated in seconds rather than through costly PDE-based simulations. In the present work, this forecasting framework is reformulated to handle non-isothermal conditions by explicitly incorporating thermal information into the model architecture. Grain size distributions are encoded using a convolutional neural network, thermal descriptors are embedded through a dedicated multilayer perceptron, and temporal evolution is predicted using a recurrent network. Instantaneous temperature and thermal rate are provided at each time step, allowing the model to adapt its predictions to changing thermal conditions. The framework is trained and evaluated on datasets generated from validated front-tracking simulations across a wide range of non-isothermal thermal paths. The results show that the thermally conditioned model accurately reproduces grain growth dynamics under complex thermal histories, achieving, in k-fold cross-validation over all simulations, mean relative errors of 2.99% (one-hour cycles) and 4.51% (four-hour cycles) with coefficients of determination exceeding 0.99, and mean relative errors between 1.91% and 14.66% on ten simulations following four unseen thermal histories of increasing complexity.

AI.tldr: 将晶粒尺寸分布视为时间序列，用CNN编码尺寸分布、MLP嵌入热学描述符、循环网络预测演化，实现非等温热循环下晶粒生长的快速预测。
AI.motivation: 传统front-tracking/front-capturing等PDE数值模拟虽准确但计算成本高，难以用于长时间或非等温热循环；此前基于RNN的预测仅在等温条件下有效，无法处理变化的温度历史。
AI.method: 重构预测框架以引入热信息：CNN编码晶粒尺寸分布，专用MLP嵌入热学描述符，循环网络预测时间演化；每个时间步输入瞬时温度与升温速率，使模型自适应变化的热条件。数据由已验证的front-tracking模拟在广泛非等温热路径上生成，采用k折交叉验证评估。
AI.result: 热条件模型能准确再现复杂热历史下的晶粒生长动力学；k折交叉验证平均相对误差为2.99%（1小时循环）和4.51%（4小时循环），决定系数均超过0.99；在四条未见过的递增复杂度热历史的十个模拟上，平均相对误差为1.91%–14.66%。
AI.conclusion: 显式引入温度与热速率信息的混合神经网络可高效、准确地预测非等温晶粒生长，秒级生成完整演化轨迹，替代昂贵的PDE模拟，适用于复杂热循环场景。

title: Longitudinal and Transverse Thermoelectric Properties in Topological Quantum Materials
summary: Thermoelectric materials can be topologically trivial or non-trivial, enabling reversible interconversion of heat and electricity using a solid-state technology. Incidentally, few of the first experimentally discovered 3D topological materials, namely, Bi, Sb, Sn and Pb-based chalcogenides, were long known as good thermoelectric materials. In these compounds, the heavy atoms that give rise to strong spin-orbit coupling often become essential for band inversion and non-trivial band topology. They lead to low lattice thermal conductivity, linearly dispersing Dirac-like bands induce high electrical mobility, and a band-inverted electronic structure with multiple band extrema gives rise to high Seebeck coefficients. In materials, where the applied temperature gradient induces electrical voltage (Seebeck effect) in the same direction, they are termed as longitudinal thermoelectrics. On the other hand, when the generated electrical voltage and applied thermal current remain orthogonal to each other, the materials are termed as transverse thermoelectrics. The transverse response can be driven by an additional external magnetic field (ordinary Nernst effect), intrinsic remanent magnetisation, or non-zero Berry curvature of a material, which arises from their non-trivial topology (anomalous Nernst effect). We discuss another class of quantum materials, known as goniopolar materials, that exhibit axis-dependent conduction polarity and hence transverse thermoelectric effects, which are based on mechanisms of longitudinal thermoelectric properties. In this review, we cover both types of thermoelectricity, focusing on materials that possess non-trivial topological order. We make connections between their structures, topology and transport properties and suggest tunability of thermoelectric properties going beyond conventional mechanisms such as electron-phonon interactions.

AI.tldr: 综述拓扑材料中的纵向与横向热电效应，重点讨论非平庸拓扑序材料的结构-拓扑-输运关联及其可调性。
AI.motivation: 早期实验发现的3D拓扑材料（Bi、Sb、Sn、Pb基硫族化合物）本来就是优良热电材料，其重原子带来强自旋轨道耦合、能带反转与非平庸拓扑，同时赋予低晶格热导、高迁移率和大多重能谷高塞贝克系数；本文意在系统梳理拓扑与热电性能之间的内在联系。
AI.method: 以综述方式把热电响应分为两类：纵向热电（塞贝克效应，电压与热流同向）和横向热电（电压与热流正交），后者可由外磁场（普通能斯特效应）、本征剩余磁化或非平庸拓扑产生的非零贝里曲率（反常能斯特效应）驱动；并引入具有轴依赖导电极性（goniopolar）的量子材料作为基于纵向机理实现横向热电的一类。
AI.result: 建立了拓扑能带结构（能带反转、狄拉克型线性色散、多重能带极值）与热电参数（低晶格热导率、高电导迁移率、高塞贝克系数）之间的对应关系，并说明横向热电可由磁场、磁化或贝里曲率等不同机制产生。
AI.conclusion: 拓扑材料的非平庸能带拓扑为热电性能优化提供了超越电子-声子相互作用等传统机制的新途径，可通过结构与拓扑调控实现热电性能的可调性。

title: Subtle Energy Corrections Reshape Condensed-Phase Property Predictions from a Machine-Learning Interatomic Potential
summary: Accurate reproduction of electronic-structure labels by machine-learning interatomic potentials does not necessarily ensure reliable condensed-phase properties. We investigate the effects of basis-set superposition error (BSSE) and an explicit Axilrod-Teller-Muto (ATM) three-body dispersion contribution on molecular-liquid predictions. Starting from MACELES-OFF, we fine-tune a baseline potential at the $ω$B97M-V/def2-TZVPD level. A separate branch learns counterpoise (CP) energy and force corrections with the baseline frozen, while a D4-parametrized ATM term is added during molecular-dynamics inference. Mean atom-normalized CP and ATM contributions are 0.222 and 0.205 meV/atom, respectively, for the analyzed SPICE2 configurations from OMol25. We compare baseline, CP-only, ATM-only, and CP + ATM variants for 39 organic liquids. Relative to baseline, the mean system-wise density changes are -1.17%, -10.38%, and -11.93% for CP-only, ATM-only, and CP + ATM, respectively; the corresponding enthalpy-of-vaporization changes are -2.79%, -14.74%, and -18.32%. For the 11 liquids with experimental self-diffusion data, the mean self-diffusion changes are +17.66%, +203.02%, and +230.36%. Both corrections thus lower density and enthalpy of vaporization while increasing molecular mobility on average. ATM dominates these changes, while CP provides a smaller contribution; their combination yields the largest average shifts. These results show that corrections with sub-meV/atom mean values on the analyzed configurations can substantially reshape the predicted structural, thermodynamic, and transport properties of molecular liquids.

AI.tldr: 该文研究基组叠加误差(BSSE/CP)与显式ATM三体色散修正对分子液体性质预测的影响，发现虽平均仅约0.2 meV/atom的修正却显著改变密度、汽化焓和自扩散系数。
AI.motivation: 机器学习原子间势能准确复现电子结构标签，并不必然保证凝聚相性质可靠。作者希望厘清 BSSE（CP 修正）与缺失的显式 ATM 三体色散项这两类误差，对分子液体宏观预测的实际影响。
AI.method: 以 MACELES-OFF 为基础，在 ωB97M-V/def2-TZVPD 水平微调基线势；单开一支冻结基线学习 counterpoise (CP) 能量与力的修正；推理（MD）阶段额外加入 D4 参数化的 ATM 三体项，对比 baseline、CP-only、ATM-only、CP+ATM 四种变体。
AI.result: OMol25 中 SPICE2 构型的平均 CP 与 ATM 贡献分别为 0.222 和 0.205 meV/atom。相对基线，39 种有机液体的体系平均密度变化为 -1.17%、-10.38%、-11.93%（CP、ATM、CP+ATM）；汽化焓变化 -2.79%、-14.74%、-18.32%；11 种有实验数据的液体自扩散系数变化 +17.66%、+203.02%、+230.36%。两类修正均降低密度与汽化焓、提高分子迁移率，ATM 占主导，CP 贡献较小，二者叠加效果最大。
AI.conclusion: 在分析构型上平均仅亚 meV/atom 量级的修正，仍能实质性重塑分子液体的结构、热力学与输运性质预测，说明高精度标签复现不足以保障凝聚相可靠性，需显式考虑 BSSE 与多体色散。

title: SO3LR Tauri: Generally Applicable Force Fields for Reactive (Bio)Molecular Simulations Covering the Periodic Table
summary: Machine-learned force fields (MLFFs) aim to create a unified model that describes all major classes of (bio)molecules at quantum-mechanical accuracy. We present SO3LR Tauri, a family of MLFFs developed toward this goal, coupling a fast SO3krates network to explicit, physics-based interaction modules: pair-specific short-range repulsion, environment-dependent dispersion, and electrostatics, each improved beyond its original formulation. The models are trained on 148 million structures spanning 85 elements, drawn from several quantum-chemical datasets. Against coupled-cluster references, the models accurately reproduce nucleobase-pair and charged protein-ligand interactions, carbohydrate conformer ordering, and molecular dipoles. They also resolve the transition pathways of organic and enzymatic reactions. Dynamical simulations recover experimental densities of water and organic solvents, the hydration structure of mono- and divalent ions, the pKa values of amino-acid side chains, and the structure and dynamics of proteins, membranes, nucleic acids, glycoproteins, and metal-containing biomolecules, all without system-specific fitting. Released in three sizes, the models reach 0.7-3.2 $μ$s/atom and scale to 27-84 million atoms on a single GPU. Much work remains to be done: achieving predictive accuracy for static and dynamic liquid properties, reaction barriers, coverage of chemical and conformational space, and the sampling and inference speed needed to describe biomolecular processes.

AI.tldr: 提出SO3LR Tauri系列机器学习力场，将SO3krates网络与基于物理的短程排斥、色散和静电模块耦合，在8500万结构、85种元素上训练，以高精度重现生物分子相互作用、反应路径及动力学性质，并实现单GPU上数千原子级（27-84M原子）的高效模拟。
AI.motivation: 现有机器学习力场难以用统一模型以量子力学精度描述所有主要类别的（生物）分子，需要兼顾精度、物理可解释性与大规模模拟效率。
AI.method: 将快速的SO3krates等变网络与显式物理相互作用模块耦合：成对特定的短程排斥、环境依赖的色散以及静电模块（均在原始公式上改进）；在来自多个量子化学数据集、覆盖85种元素、1.48亿结构上训练；发布三种模型规模。
AI.result: 对CCSD(T)参考，准确再现核碱基配对、带电蛋白-配体相互作用、碳水化合物构象排序与分子偶极；解析有机与酶反应过渡路径；动力学模拟重现水与有机溶剂密度、单价/二价离子水合结构、氨基酸侧链pKa、蛋白/膜/核酸/糖蛋白/含金属生物分子结构与动力学，无需系统特定拟合；速度0.7-3.2 μs/atom，单GPU可扩展至2700-8400万原子。
AI.conclusion: SO3LR Tauri展现了统一生物分子力场的可行性与广泛适用性，但在静态与动态液体性质、反应势垒的预测精度、化学与构象空间覆盖以及生物分子过程所需的采样与推理速度方面仍需大量改进。

title: All reweighted paths lead to Rome: Unification of reweighting schemes for stratified path sampling
summary: Path sampling-based stratification algorithms such as Transition Interface Sampling (TIS) enable the evaluation of kinetic rate constants and mechanisms of complex molecular rare event transitions. By sampling only short dynamical trajectories, TIS allows constructing an estimate of the unbiased dynamics by reweighting the interface path ensembles. In the past decades several methods have been developed and applied to achieve such path reweighting, based on statistically optimal use of the trajectory data. Why and how this reweighting exactly works has been underexplored up to now. Here we discuss several different schemes to compute the reweighted path ensemble (RPE), notably point-wise matching, Weighted Histogram Analysis Method (WHAM), Multistate Bennett Acceptance Ratio (MBAR), variance based reweighting (VBR) and survival analysis reweighting (SAR). We show that except for the point-wise matching the other methods are leading to the same outcome, and in fact can be seen as identical. Moreover, the SAR links to a well-established nonparametric maximum-likelihood estimator of product-limit form. This allows a synthesis of all path reweighting schemes, identifying the common underlying nature. All schemes follow from this common origin. We illustrate the reweighting with some simple examples, and show that care has to be taken when applying WHAM, if the number of interfaces and histogram bins do not match.

AI.tldr: 本文系统比较了TIS中多种路径重加权方案，证明除逐点匹配外，WHAM、MBAR、方差重加权VBR和生存分析重加权SAR本质等价，并可用product-limit形式的非参数极大似然估计统一。
AI.motivation: 路径采样（如TIS）通过重加权界面路径系综估计无偏动力学，但过去几十年发展出的多种重加权方法为何有效、如何工作一直缺乏深入理解，本文旨在厘清其原理与相互关系。
AI.method: 比较逐点匹配（point-wise matching）、WHAM、MBAR、方差重加权（VBR）与生存分析重加权（SAR）五种计算重加权路径系综（RPE）的方案，并通过与product-limit形式的非参数极大似然估计建立联系来综合分析。
AI.result: 除逐点匹配外，其余方法给出相同结果，可视为同一方法；SAR与product-limit非参数极大似然估计相联系，从而统一所有重加权方案并揭示共同内在本质。简单示例验证了这一点，并发现当界面数与直方图bin数不匹配时WHAM需谨慎使用。
AI.conclusion: 所有路径重加权方案源于同一共同基础，可由该统一框架导出；实践上应避免界面数与bin数不匹配时的WHAM误用。

title: Effective Harmonic and Anharmonic Models for Vibronic Spectra
comment: 22 pages, 14 figures; 85 pages of Supporting Information appended. Standalone code: https://github.com/yogibubu/SATI-standalone
summary: Vibrationally resolved spectra of medium-sized molecules contain dense progressions, weak borrowed-intensity bands and large-amplitude structural motions. Their interpretation requires state-to-state assignments together with a complete spectral envelope, while a fully anharmonic treatment of every normal coordinate is usually impractical. We introduce a general workflow that builds both outputs from automatically generated nonredundant internal coordinates and a common transition-operator representation. The harmonic level combines time-independent (TI) assignments with time-dependent (TD) thermal correlations and an explicit omitted-strength bound for the positive harmonic dipole sum. A discrete-variable representation (DVR) promotes selected flexible coordinates while the remaining modes are contracted analytically. Perturbative and variational nuclear states extend the same operator treatment to separate-state modes with Duschinsky mixing or to shared modes with residual quadratic couplings. The workflow recovers approximately 99% of the harmonic intensity for strongly reorganized medium-sized examples, reproduces measured absorption and fluorescence trends for anthracene and p-terphenyl, and gives signed electronic circular dichroism (ECD) profiles for camphor. Water photoionization, a diffuse-basis two-photon response tensor for the pyrazine $n\to3s$ Rydberg band, and nonplanar 4-pyrone calculations test continuum and anharmonic extensions. The result is a unified route from molecular structure to resolved assignments and numerically converged finite-model spectra.

AI.tldr: 提出一套从分子结构出发、统一生成振动分辨光谱指认与数值收敛谱包络的通用工作流，通过调和层TI指认+TD热关联、DVR选择性非谐处理与解析收缩、微扰/变分核态扩展，兼顾效率与精度。
AI.motivation: 中等尺寸分子的振动分辨光谱含密集谱带、弱借强度带与大振幅结构运动，需同时给出态-态指认和完整谱包络；但对所有简正坐标做完全非谐处理通常不可行，缺乏兼顾二者的通用方案。
AI.method: 基于自动生成的非冗余内坐标与统一的跃迁算符表示；调和层结合时间无关(TI)指认、时间相关(TD)热关联及正调和偶极和遗漏强度上界；用DVR提升选定柔性坐标，其余模式解析收缩；微扰与变分核态将同一算符处理扩展到含Duschinsky混合的分离态模式及含残余二次耦合的共享模式。
AI.result: 强重组的 medium 分子示例中恢复约99%的调和强度；重现蒽与对联三苯的吸收和荧光趋势；给出樟脑带符号的ECD谱；并用水光电离、吡嗪n→3s Rydberg带的弥散基双光子响应张量及非平面4-吡喃酮计算检验连续谱与非谐扩展。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提供从分子结构到分辨指认与数值收敛有限模型光谱的统一路线，兼具调和效率与非谐精度。

title: Exploiting floating point emulation in tensor contractions in relativistic coupled cluster theory
summary: In this manuscript we outline a computational strategy to leverage a vendor-optimized implementation of the Ozaki scheme I for floating point emulation as part of an implementation of the Transpose-Transpose-GEMM-Transpose (TTGT) pattern for tensor contractions, and assess its potential to accelerate two of the most expensive tensor contractions appearing in relativistic coupled cluster theory in high-end accelerators such as the NVIDIA Blackwell B200 system in which there is a strong differential in the performance of computations for double and lower precision datatypes. Our results indicate that this emulation-based TTGT strategy can provide significant speedups compared to runs without emulation, and can be competitive with state-of-the-art, vendor-optimized tensor contraction libraries using native double precision as compute datatype. More importantly, our scheme provides a path towards easily allowing users to tune the desired accuracy in the tensor contraction steps, including cases where precision between single and double is sufficient for the application.

AI.tldr: 本文提出利用厂商优化的Ozaki方案I浮点仿真实现TTGT张量收缩模式，用于加速相对论耦合簇理论中最昂贵的张量收缩，并在NVIDIA B200上验证其可行性与加速效果。
AI.motivation: 高端加速器（如Blackwell B200）上双精度与低精度计算性能存在巨大差异，而相对论耦合簇理论中的张量收缩是计算瓶颈，因此希望借助低精度仿真来充分利用硬件算力。
AI.method: 采用Ozaki方案I的厂商优化实现进行浮点仿真，将其嵌入TTGT（Transpose-Transpose-GEMM-Transpose）模式的张量收缩实现中，并在NVIDIA Blackwell B200系统上评估性能。
AI.result: 基于仿真的TTGT策略相比无仿真运行可获得显著加速，性能可与使用原生双精度的业界最优厂商优化张量收缩库相竞争。
AI.conclusion: 该方案为用户提供了灵活调节张量收缩精度的手段，支持单精度与双精度之间的精度需求，为低精度仿真加速科学计算提供了可行路径。

title: Exact periodic electrostatics for latent-charge machine-learning potentials
summary: Machine-learning interatomic potentials of the latent Ewald summation (LES) type learn atomic charges from energies and forces and evaluate their electrostatic energy in reciprocal space. I formulate this long-range term as a smeared Epstein-Hurwitz lattice sum and derive its exact periodic structure: a decomposition isolating a net-charge artefact and a local self-energy, an image theorem for cells of any shape, and the forces and virial. Full charge equilibration, LES with induced charges, constrained and unconstrained LES models and fixed-charge force fields follow as successive approximations of one variational problem, whose diagonal-hardness limit is a projection of the latent charges onto fixed total charge, which I call projected latent Ewald summation (pLES). Energies and forces determine the latent charges only up to a gauge, so fragment-level rather than atom-level charge quantization is the consistent target. The latent channel is guaranteed to be a dielectric only if charge is conserved locally; charges that are local functions of the environment and conserved only globally can screen like a conductor. pLES is implemented in the atomic cluster expansion and in LAMMPS, and the exact identities hold to machine precision, also for trained models. For charged NaCl clusters, pLES recovers the total charge that an unconstrained model misses by up to 1.8 e and reduces the test errors of a short-range model from 1.44 to 0.42 meV/atom and from 37 to 13 meV/Å. In two water datasets, constrained and unconstrained models learn the same latent charges up to sign and scale. In molecular dynamics of pLES water, fluctuating molecular charges dominate the screening at all accessible wavelengths; a crossover model excludes a conductor and gives a latent dielectric constant between 19 and 71; molecular charges are compensated over about 1 nm, beyond the training cells.

AI.tldr: 作者将LES型机器学习原子间势的长程静电项表述为涂抹Epstein-Hurwitz格和，推导其精确周期结构（净电荷伪影分离、局域自能、任意形状晶胞的镜像定理及力与virial），并将电荷均衡、固定电荷力场等统一为一个变分问题的逐级近似，提出pLES（投影潜隐Ewald求和）。pLES在ACE和LAMMPS中实现，对带电NaCl团簇恢复未约束模型最多缺失的1.8 e总电荷，并将短程模型测试误差从1.44降至0.42 meV/atom、37降至13 meV/Å。
AI.motivation: LES型势从能量和力学习原子电荷，但其长程静电项的周期结构与物理一致性缺乏严格刻画：存在净电荷伪影、规范不定性，以及潜隐通道何时表现为介电而非导体的问题需要澄清。
AI.method: 将LES长程项形式化为涂抹Epstein-Hurwitz格和，推导精确周期分解、镜像定理、力和virial；提出统一变分框架，使完全电荷均衡、含诱导电荷的LES、约束/无约束LES与固定电荷力场成为逐级近似，其对角硬度极限为pLES（将潜隐电荷投影到固定总电荷）；在原子团簇展开（ACE）与LAMMPS中实现并训练验证。
AI.result: 精确恒等式在机器精度内成立（含已训练模型）。带电NaCl团簇上pLES恢复总电荷（未约束模型偏差达1.8 e），短程模型测试误差由1.44降至0.42 meV/atom、37降至13 meV/Å。两个水数据集上约束与无约束模型学到相同潜隐电荷（至符号与尺度）。pLES水分子动力学中涨落分子电荷在所有可达波长主导屏蔽；交叉模型排除导体，给出19–71的潜隐介电常数；分子电荷在约1 nm尺度补偿，超出训练晶胞。
AI.conclusion: 能量与力只能把潜隐电荷确定到规范不定，因此一致的目标是片段级而非原子级电荷量子化；仅当电荷局域守恒时潜隐通道才是介电体，仅全局守恒且为环境局域函数的电荷可像导体一样屏蔽。pLES为长程机器学习势提供了理论上严谨、可直接工程化的方案。

title: Brueckner Orbitals in Local Pair Natural Orbital Coupled-Cluster Theory: DLPNO-BCCD(T) and DLPNO-BCCD(T)_Lambda2
summary: In this work, we implement closed-shell Brueckner orbitals for the efficient domain-based local pair natural orbital DLPNO-CCSD(T) and DLPNO-CCSD(T)$_Λ$ methods of the free and open-source \textsc{Psi4} package. We introduce a new algorithm that allows Brueckner orbitals to be computed within the DLPNO framework, resulting in the novel DLPNO-BCCD(T) and DLPNO-BCCD(T)$_{Λ_2}$ methods. We show that DLPNO-BCCD(T) approximates its canonical BCCD(T) counterpart with significantly lower errors relative to the errors incurred by DLPNO-CCSD(T) over CCSD(T). Through a test on the S22 set of noncovalent dimers, the peak error across the set is reduced from 0.36 kcal mol$^{-1}$ to 0.25 kcal mol$^{-1}$ using normal cutoffs, and 0.28 kcal mol$^{-1}$ to 0.13 kcal mol$^{-1}$ at tight cutoffs. In addition, we show that BCCD(T)$_{Λ_2}$, a ${Λ_2}$-only implementation of Brueckner orbitals for the asymmetric triples method, generally produces the best agreement with CCSDT, compared to the (T), (T)$_Λ$, and B(T) perturbative triples corrections. This is established through benchmarks on thermochemistry tests on the barrier heights of semibullvalene and bullvalene Cope rearrangement, while the robustness of DLPNO-BCCD(T)$_{Λ_2}$ is demonstrated along bond-breaking potential energy curves, where it matches the orbital-optimized quasi-variational asymmetric renormalized-triples OQVCCDAR(T) method closely for single-bond breaking, and approximates DLPNO-CCSDT respectably even when triple bonds are stretched, at a fraction of the computational cost.

AI.tldr: 该工作将闭壳层Brueckner轨道引入Psi4的DLPNO-CCSD(T)/(T)Λ方法，提出新算法得到DLPNO-BCCD(T)与DLPNO-BCCD(T)Λ₂，显著降低局域近似误差并改善对CCSDT的逼近。
AI.motivation: DLPNO-CCSD(T)相对正则CCSD(T)存在局域近似误差（如S22上峰值误差可达0.36 kcal/mol），希望借助Brueckner轨道（对轨道旋转不敏感、单激发振幅趋于零）降低该误差，并提升微扰三激发近似对CCSDT的逼近质量，同时保持DLPNO的低计算成本。
AI.method: 在开源Psi4中实现闭壳层Brueckner轨道用于DLPNO-CCSD(T)与DLPNO-CCSD(T)Λ；提出可在DLPNO框架内计算Brueckner轨道的新算法，从而构建DLPNO-BCCD(T)与仅含Λ₂的非对称三激发版本DLPNO-BCCD(T)Λ₂；以S22非共价二聚体集合、半牛瓦烯与牛瓦烯Cope重排势垒、以及键断裂势能曲线进行基准测试，并与BCCD(T)、(T)、(T)Λ、B(T)、OQVCCDAR(T)及DLPNO-CCSDT比较。
AI.result: DLPNO-BCCD(T)逼近正则BCCD(T)的误差显著低于DLPNO-CCSD(T)相对CCSD(T)的误差：S22峰值误差常规截断下由0.36降至0.25 kcal/mol，紧截断下由0.28降至0.13 kcal/mol。DLPNO-BCCD(T)Λ₂在Cope重排势垒热化学测试中与CCSDT的一致性通常优于(T)、(T)Λ与B(T)；在键断裂曲线上，单键断裂时与OQVCCDAR(T)高度吻合，三键拉伸时也能较好地近似DLPNO-CCSDT，且成本仅为其一小部分。
AI.conclusion: Brueckner轨道可有效缓解DLPNO框架的局域近似误差，DLPNO-BCCD(T)与DLPNO-BCCD(T)Λ₂在精度与成本间取得良好平衡，适合作为DLPNO-CCSD(T)系列的高精度替代方案，并已在开源Psi4中可用。

title: Machine Learning the Complete Active-Space Wavefunction Reconstruction
summary: Machine-learned interatomic potentials enable multireference-quality reaction dynamics but do not retain the electronic structure underlying the predicted energies and forces. Recovering this information by independently performing complete active space self-consistent field (CASSCF) calculations is both expensive and potentially inconsistent. We introduce the Complete Active-Space Wave Function Reconstruction (CAS-WR) model, which learns the geometry-dependent electronic structure from CASSCF data and reconstructs the CAS wave function without repeated orbital optimization. Combined with uncertainty-based active learning, CAS-WR is demonstrated for the Diels--Alder reaction and \ce{TiC+}-catalyzed C--H activation. The approach enables trajectory-resolved analysis of multiconfigurational electronic structure across reactive ensembles. Preliminary applications to excited-state proton transfer and transition-metal photocatalysis suggest that CAS-WR can provide a general route toward recovering electronic structure along complex ground- and excited-state reactive dynamics.

AI.tldr: 提出CAS-WR模型，从CASSCF数据学习几何依赖的电子结构，无需重复轨道优化即可重建CAS波函数，实现反应动力学中的多组态电子结构分析。
AI.motivation: 机器学习原子间势能提供多参考质量的反应动力学，但不保留预测能量和力背后的电子结构；独立进行CASSCF计算既昂贵又可能不一致。
AI.method: CAS-WR（Complete Active-Space Wave Function Reconstruction）模型，学习几何依赖的电子结构并重建CAS波函数，避免重复轨道优化；结合基于不确定性的主动学习。
AI.result: 在Diels-Alder反应和TiC+催化的C-H活化中得到验证，实现反应系综中多组态电子结构的轨迹分辨分析；在激发态质子转移和过渡金属光催化的初步应用中显示可行性。
AI.conclusion: CAS-WR为沿复杂基态与激发态反应动力学恢复电子结构提供了一条通用途径。

title: Open-shell Configuration State Functions as trial states for phaseless auxiliary-field quantum Monte Carlo
summary: The accurate description of open-shell states in molecular systems poses challenges for approximate electronic structure methods. One emerging approach is to variationally optimize the orbitals of a single user-selected Configuration State Function (CSF), i.e., a linear combination of Slater determinants that is constructed as an eigenstate of the total spin operator. In this work we explore the use of these orbital-optimized single CSFs as trial wavefunctions in phaseless auxiliary-field quantum Monte Carlo (ph-AFQMC), a stochastic method that recovers electron correlation by evolving an initial state in imaginary time, subject to a constraint imposed by the trial state. We investigate the symmetric stretch of H-He-H, a series of small $p$-block compounds with diradicaloid singlet states, twisted ethene conformers, and a bimetallic iron-sulfur complex. We find that accurate energetics are obtained for states dominated by open-shell character, and that for certain atoms and diatomics the accuracy can be significantly improved when the trial is made to also preserve the relevant angular momentum symmetries. Furthermore, our study reveals that the open-shell CSF trial is suboptimal when the target electronic state reflects a significant mixture of ionic and covalent character, e.g., at shorter bond lengths in H-He-H and for the superexchange-stabilized ground state of [2Fe-2S]$^{2+}$. Our findings suggest that ph-AFQMC using CSF trial states is a promising method for many (but not all) strongly correlated molecular states, especially given its relatively low computational cost, and that it provides a reasonable non-perturbative way to recover some of the dynamic correlation that is otherwise missing in the CSF.

AI.tldr: 本文评估了以轨道优化的单一构型态函数(CSF)作为试探波函数用于无相位辅助场量子蒙特卡洛(ph-AFQMC)的效果，发现其对开壳层主导的强关联态精度良好，但对离子-共价混合态表现欠佳。
AI.motivation: 分子体系开壳层态的精确描述对近似电子结构方法构成挑战；单一CSF变分优化轨道是一种新兴方案，但缺少动态相关，需要评估其作为ph-AFQMC试探态的效果。
AI.method: 将用户选定单一CSF的轨道进行变分优化，作为ph-AFQMC的试探波函数；在H-He-H对称拉伸、小型p区双自由基单重态化合物、扭转乙烯构象及双金属铁硫配合物上测试；并考察试探态保持角动量对称性的影响。
AI.result: 对开壳层主导的态可获得准确能量，部分原子和二原子分子在试探态保持角动量对称性时精度显著提升；但当目标态包含显著离子-共价混合时（如H-He-H短键长、[2Fe-2S]^{2+}超交换稳定的基态），开壳层CSF试探态表现次优。
AI.conclusion: 基于CSF试探态的ph-AFQMC对许多（但非全部）强关联分子态是有前景的方法，计算成本较低，并以非微扰方式合理恢复CSF中缺失的部分动态相关。

title: When optimized geometries are not optimal: Implications for inverted singlet-triplet gap predictions
summary: Pseudo-Jahn-Teller distortions can substantially alter singlet-triplet gaps, potentially reversing the predicted excited-state ordering in molecules proposed to exhibit inverted singlet-triplet (INVEST) gaps. In this study, we benchmark geometry optimization methods for 13 azaphenalenes against CCSD(T)-quality reference geometries, assessing their ability to reproduce symmetry lowering and its consequences for singlet-triplet gaps. Among the methods examined, $ω$B97M-D4 reliably describes the distorted geometries and corresponding gaps, whereas the commonly used methods B3LYP and MP2 retain high-symmetry structures, potentially leading to false-positive INVEST assignments. We further assess $ω$B97M-D4 geometries across 337 molecules comprising azaphenalenes, boron/nitrogen-substituted polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbons, and non-alternant hydrocarbons. Subsequent L-CC2/aug-cc-pVDZ calculations predict negative singlet-triplet gaps for 85 molecules and identify discrepancies with previously reported INVEST assignments. These findings demonstrate that the choice of geometry optimization method is crucial for reliable INVEST screening, particularly in systems susceptible to symmetry-breaking distortions.

AI.tldr: 几何优化方法的选择对INVEST（倒置单-三重态能隙）分子筛选至关重要：常用方法B3LYP和MP2会保留高对称结构，可能造成假阳性，而ωB97M-D4能可靠重现畸变几何与能隙。
AI.motivation: 赝姜-泰勒畸变会显著改变单-三重态能隙，甚至逆转分子的激发态次序，从而影响INVEST分子的判断；而以往筛选常忽略几何优化方法带来的对称性破缺问题。
AI.method: 以CCSD(T)级别参考几何为基准，对13个氮杂萉烯（azaphenalene）体系评测多种几何优化方法（ωB97M-D4、B3LYP、MP2等）重现对称性降低及相应单-三重态能隙的能力；随后用ωB97M-D4优化337个分子（氮杂萉烯、硼/氮取代多环芳烃、非交替烃），并以L-CC2/aug-cc-pVDZ计算能隙。
AI.result: ωB97M-D4能可靠描述畸变几何及能隙；B3LYP与MP2保持高对称结构，可能导致INVEST假阳性判定。在337个分子中，85个被预测具有负单-三重态能隙，且与先前报道的INVEST指认存在分歧。
AI.conclusion: 几何优化方法的选择对可靠的INVEST筛选至关重要，尤其对易发生对称性破缺畸变的体系；应避免使用可能维持高对称性的方法，以防错误指认。

title: Discovering like a scientist: Literature-informed dimensionless learning for physical closure of data-driven equations
summary: Data-driven methods can recover compact equations, yet the physical dependence of their coefficients across operating conditions often remains unresolved. Dimensionless groups can explain this variation, but selecting relevant groups from the many dimensionally admissible combinations remains challenging. Here, we introduce a knowledge-guided framework for dimensionless learning, called π-former. It learns patterns of variable association and exponent assignment from a corpus of 1,288 established dimensionless groups. Under exact dimensional constraints, the model proposes interpretable basic groups whose combinations are optimized against observations. Across seven physical problems, the framework identifies predictive dimensionless coordinates within seconds. Integration with equation discovery further expresses condition-dependent coefficients through these coordinates, recovering established physical scalings in multi-condition simulations. Applied to experimental measurements of evaporation-driven wetting, the framework discovers dimensionless coordinates and uses them to construct a unified trajectory equation. The resulting model generalizes to held-out conditions across liquids and initial volumes, outperforming existing empirical models. These results establish dimensionless learning as a transferable bridge between accumulated scientific knowledge and data-driven equation discovery, enabling artificial intelligence to uncover physically meaningful laws from observations.

AI.tldr: 提出知识引导的无量纲学习框架π-former，从1288个已有无量纲组中学习变量关联与指数分配模式，在精确量纲约束下自动发现无量纲坐标，并与方程发现结合，实现跨工况的物理尺度规律恢复与实验泛化。
AI.motivation: 数据驱动方法能恢复紧凑方程，但其系数随工况变化的物理依赖未被解决；无量纲群可解释这种变化，但从大量量纲允许的组合中挑选相关群十分困难。
AI.method: 从1288个已确立的无量纲群语料中学习变量关联与指数分配规律；在精确量纲约束下提出可解释的基础群，并针对观测数据优化群的组合；再与方程发现整合，用无量纲坐标表达随条件变化的系数。
AI.result: 在七个物理问题上数秒内找到具预测力的无量纲坐标；多工况仿真中恢复了已有物理标度律；在蒸发驱动润湿实验中发现无量纲坐标并构建统一轨迹方程，在未见液体与初始体积条件下泛化，优于现有经验模型。
AI.conclusion: 无量纲学习可作为连接累积科学知识与数据驱动方程发现的可迁移桥梁，使AI从观测中发掘具有物理意义的规律。
